comment:
An RFC 844 or MIME message header.  Includes methods
    for parsing headers from incoming streams, fetching
    values, setting values, and printing headers.
    Key values of null are legal: they indicate lines in
    the header that don't have a valid key, but do have
    a value (this isn't legal according to the standard,
    but lines like this are everywhere).

methods.name: public synchronized String getHeaderNamesInList()
methods.comment: * Returns list of header names in a comma separated list

methods.name: public synchronized void reset()
methods.comment: * Reset a message header (all key/values removed)

methods.name: public synchronized String findValue(String k)
methods.comment:
* Find the value that corresponds to this key.
     * It finds only the first occurrence of the key.
     * @param k the key to find.
     * @return null if not found.

methods.name: public synchronized int getKey(String k)
methods.comment: return the location of the key

methods.name: public synchronized String findNextValue(String k, String v)
methods.comment:

methods.name: public boolean filterNTLMResponses(String k)
methods.comment:
* Removes bare Negotiate and Kerberos headers when an "NTLM ..."
     * appears. All Performed on headers with key being k.
     * @return true if there is a change

methods.name: public Iterator<String> multiValueIterator(String k)
methods.comment:
* return an Iterator that returns all values of a particular
     * key in sequence

methods.name: public synchronized Map<String, List<String>> getHeaders(String[] excludeList)
public synchronized Map<String, List<String>> filterAndAddHeaders(String[] excludeList, Map<String, List<String>> include)
public synchronized void print(PrintStream p)
methods.comment:
Prints the key-value pairs represented by this
        header.  Also prints the RFC required blank line
        at the end. Omits pairs with a null key.

methods.name: public synchronized void add(String k, String v)
methods.comment:
Adds a key value pair to the end of the
        header.  Duplicates are allowed

methods.name: public synchronized void prepend(String k, String v)
methods.comment:
Prepends a key value pair to the beginning of the
        header.  Duplicates are allowed

methods.name: public synchronized void set(int i, String k, String v)
public synchronized void remove(String k)
methods.comment:
* Remove the key from the header. If there are multiple values under
     * the same key, they are all removed.
     * Nothing is done if the key doesn't exist.
     * After a remove, the other pairs' order are not changed.
     * @param k the key to remove

methods.name: public synchronized void set(String k, String v)
methods.comment:
Sets the value of a key.  If the key already
        exists in the header, it's value will be
        changed.  Otherwise a new key/value pair will
        be added to the end of the header.

methods.name: public synchronized void setIfNotSet(String k, String v)
public static String canonicalID(String id)
methods.comment:
Convert a message-id string to canonical form (strips off
        leading and trailing <>s)

methods.comment: Parse a MIME header from an input stream.
